hooks.command: awk '/^## Active rules/{f=1} /^## Log/{f=0} f' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.ai/mistakes.md" | sed 's/^/[mistakes.md] /'

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! git diff --quiet -- .ai/mistakes.md 2>/dev/null; then echo '[mistakes.md] updated this session (ok)'; else echo '[mistakes.md] not updated this session. If the user corrected you or a verification failed, append an entry now.'; fi
